hypothesis: container_count, prior_shipments, and transfers may have limited influence within the high-scoring region.
observations: container_count values around 80–100 repeatedly produced scores near 0.9765 in strong configurations.
prior_shipments values from 0 to approximately 20 showed little measurable change in comparable high-scoring configurations.
transfers values from 0 through 6 repeatedly produced scores around 0.976–0.9774 in comparable high-scoring configurations.
conclusion: No strong independent effect was established for these three variables in the tested high-scoring region. They appear much less influential than port, discrepancy_ratio, shipper_score, route_age_days, recent_seizures, shipper_years, and declared_value.
